title: A project, whole; ideas told for anyone
done: From two messages of the author: how a project works belongs to the project, and its idea must tell anyone what it is. Specified in ocoeco (idea, path, workings, work); the engine shows the idea as an article; four ideas written in their own repositories; the Rhizome lens opens with Rhizome's own idea.
rejected: Nothing renamed: recommended for organizations only, and left to the author.

title: Essence, a method and a view; the lab can hear
done: Essence became its own project - the method, describing itself, with the first workings anyone has written - and the signature view: every project lands on one page that shows why, what, how and now. In the phone's lab, devlab hear played a tone on each speaker and heard both through a microphone: the first evidence there that a machine heard.
considered: Essence as a section of a specification.
rejected: That alone - and an essay with no check.

title: Every project its own view; the observatory's family; ocoeco founded
done: The path for every subject (three horizons, milestones filled by evidence, readiness earned in order); a page per project (how close, backlog, log, ideas); How we work from the canon; the observatory's family as its sub-views, ordered by the mark; ocoeco founded as the working system, its specification written, the mark, discovery and harvest moved into it - the engine is only the face; land waits for CI checks to appear; lab-agent guide teaches the living practices.
considered: tad as a top tab; renaming tad-engine in place; the engine depending on ocoeco's code.
rejected: Readiness from any done milestone (a later one lifted it); unknown as failure; whole files copied from a stale copy; merging before checks appear.

title: It tells its essence
done: Its workings: what delivers and proves each step of its path, and why we care. Steps that nothing serves yet are left empty, to be seen.
rejected: That: a step nothing serves is a wish, and should show.

title: Its idea, told for anyone
done: The idea of the observatory written as an ordered piece of writing in its own data - what it is, what it is for, a picture, its honest limit, where it stands - for a reader who knows nothing of it; shown by the observatory as an article.
rejected: Those as the idea: they name the parts for an insider.

title: Joining in one command; Rhizoid joins
done: ocoeco init and check make joining one command (fifteen repositories had been joined by hand); Rhizoid joined with it, its path reading ocoeco's own backlog for its last stop. Criteria are read in their own project first, then anywhere; lenses found but not curated are shown as discovered. Sixteen projects, no problems.
rejected: That: a template drifts; a command writes what is current.

title: The observatory in two languages
done: Languages specified (ocoeco SPEC section 9); the face renders once per language under /en/ and /ru/ with a thin switcher of languages in their own names, lang and hreflang, old addresses redirecting; Fluent catalogs with correct Russian plurals (103 коммита); sixty interface messages marked where written and resolved per page.
considered: Restructuring every formatting call for messages; translating the rendered HTML afterwards.
rejected: Translating rendered output (fragile, no grammar); plain string tables (wrong plurals); flags or codes in the switcher; switching by script.

title: Data made by work, and the first lens
done: ocoeco gatherers (activity, releases, CI) in all eleven marked repositories through one reusable workflow, shown as each project's heartbeat; shared tables read through GitHub's API (current, authoritative); lenses specified (SPEC section 8), harvested from lens.toml, and drawn by the face - Linux Phones is now a lens in its family's organization, curated into the navigation.
considered: Keeping grand views in the engine; reading raw files with a retry.
rejected: Hard-coded views (a gatekeeper); the raw file server (cached for minutes, 501 to empty files on some runners); sending the API's headers to raw files.

title: The observatory founded, discovering and publishing itself
done: The architecture written; the mark (schema 1) on seven projects; the engine in Rust (discover, harvest, site); a scheduled run that discovers, harvests, renders and publishes; the site restructured around grand projects with honest tables.
considered: A single flat site; tad's own pages; one progress percentage.
rejected: Unknown counted as failure; hand-ordered columns; prose-only design.

title: Rhizome in the picture
done: Rhizome's home (the author's manifesto, 26 concepts, 14 decisions, the Hypha roadmap, its path) and its lens, curated second; the lens gathers Rhizoid where it lives.
rejected: That, for now: it changes their addresses.

title: argenv joins; Mnemonic Vocabulary gets its place
done: argenv marked, with its own path from its real state; Mnemonic Vocabulary recorded as a grand project at the idea stage, with its own lens curated second. Gathered data moved to an oco-data branch everywhere, and automation's commits left out of activity - found through argenv's protected branch.
rejected: That: one rule for every repository.
